capabilities: Tracks word counts and daily or chapter goals
Manages chapters, timeline, foreshadowing, lore, and tasks
Provides immersive writing and manuscript modes
Tracks focus time and chapter snapshots
disambiguation: Not an AI writing generator; it is a local writing, planning, and proofreading toolkit.
extras: Proofreading dictionaries are not bundled and must be downloaded manually; snapshots require File Recovery and stay device-local; the OBS overlay polls a local HTTP endpoint.
problem: Novelists otherwise juggle separate tools for word goals, chapter planning, timeline, lore, proofreading, and focus tracking inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Requires the File Recovery core plugin

summary: All-in-one writing studio for novelists with word-count goals, chapter boards, timeline, foreshadowing, lore, proofreading, and focus tracking.
